title: ESG Data Asset ESG-DA-2026-001 - 10-sector input-output ESG matrix, FY2025
description: Verified ESG data asset: 10-sector input-output matrix with GRI / SASB / ISSB / CSRD-aligned indicators for FY2025, raw tables, calculations, verification, valuation and usage documents.

sources.name: National statistical agency - supply and use tables 2025
sources.coverage: Inter-sector flows and gross output for all 10 sectors

sources.name: Corporate sustainability reports (GRI-aligned), FY2025
sources.coverage: Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions, turnover

sources.name: Independent assurance provider - limited assurance statements

methodologies.name: Leontief input-output model
methodologies.description: Technical coefficients A = Z / x; total requirements (I - A)^-1 for the 10-sector matrix.

methodologies.name: GHG emissions disclosure
methodologies.description: Scope 1 and Scope 2 (location-based) GHG emissions in tCO2e.

methodologies.name: Employment and turnover disclosure
methodologies.description: New hires and turnover rate; water withdrawal by source.

methodologies.name: Industry-specific metrics
methodologies.reference: SASB Standards, industry codes per sector (e.g. EM-MM-110a.1, TC-SI-130a.1)
methodologies.description: Sector metrics mapped to SASB industry codes.

methodologies.name: Climate-related disclosures
methodologies.description: Cross-industry GHG metrics consistent with IFRS S2 paragraph 29(a).

methodologies.name: European sustainability reporting
methodologies.reference: ESRS E1-6 (GHG emissions), ESRS S1-6 (own workforce characteristics)
methodologies.description: Data points required under the CSRD delegated act.

methodologies.name: Output-based valuation
methodologies.description: Token supply equals modelled output value in USD; one token represents one USD of output.

usage_recommendations: Use 01_Raw_Data for model inputs; 02_Metrics_Calculations contains derived figures only.
Verify every file against README_manifest.json (sha256) before use; the block content hash commits to this manifest.
Treat rows with verification_status = pending_review as provisional.
Cite the data asset by block id ESG-DA-2026-001 and the content hash.
Licensing: token holders may use the package internally; redistribution requires a separate licence (06_Usage_Recommendations/licensing_terms.pdf).
